Hi {{46.`Pilot First Name`}},

Thank you for submitting your helicopter landing agreement for Wise Winery.

Attached is your completed Helicopter Landing Agreement and Pilot Indemnity form. Please review the details to ensure everything is correct, including your pilot and aircraft information.

This agreement is valid for 1 year from today's date. You will be emailed 1 month before it's due for renewal.

If any updates are required or your contact details change, feel free to get in touch.

Please remember to call us 60 minutes before landing: (08) 9755 3331

Safe flying,
